bubble_burst.name: Bubble Burst
bubble_burst.description: Fire a high-speed bubble that shatters obstacles in its path. Time it perfectly for a faster, bigger burst!

echo_shield.name: Echo Shield
echo_shield.description: Summon a shimmering shield that absorbs one hit. Activate before danger strikes!

magnet_pulse.name: Magnet Pulse
magnet_pulse.description: Emit a pulse that pulls nearby pearls directly to you for 3 beats.

beat_dash.name: Beat Dash
beat_dash.description: Blink forward through obstacles for one beat — untouchable for a split second!

phase_bubble.name: Phase Bubble
phase_bubble.description: Encase yourself in a ghost bubble — pass through one obstacle type for 2 beats.
